push.lead: 两个从口袋掉出的球，两种判罚。

editorial.question: 同样是口袋掉球，为什么第一次判失分、第二次却重打？
editorial.thesis: 上海大师赛第三轮，弗里茨决胜盘 2-5 发球局连续两分口袋掉球：30-30 那次主裁喊 let，但视频回看显示叫停在他击球之后，分已打完，判给西西帕斯成赛点；赛点上再掉球，按 ATP 规则书这才是第一次 let，重新打。西西帕斯错失三个赛点后在下一局发球胜赛，3-6 7-5 6-3。
beats: 中段：第一次掉球、视频回看、赛点；第二次掉球、西西帕斯抗议；规则图解两次判罚的逻辑；主裁原话。
结局：弗里茨救下赛点，西西帕斯下一局胜赛；落在规则问题上。

human_context.angle: 一条很少有人讲清楚的规则：let 数的是叫停重打的次数，不是掉球的次数。
facts: ATP 规则书 7.22 F 2(a)：口袋掉球属无意妨碍，可叫 let；制造妨碍的球员须被告知，下一次因其类似行为被主裁叫停将判失分。
主裁现场：Well, but the first one, he already lost the point. It was not replayed.

_facts.result: ATP https://www.atptour.com/en/news/tsitsipas-fritz-shanghai-2026-monday（2026-10-12）：西西帕斯 3-6 7-5 6-3 胜 11 号种子弗里茨进第四轮；弗里茨 2-5 发球时连续两分口袋掉球；西西帕斯这一局错失三个赛点，下一局胜赛，用时 2 小时 13 分。
_facts.first_drop: Tennis Temple https://en.tennistemple.com/actu/two-balls-fall-from-fritzs-pocket-in-wild-shanghai/UY3T 与 Tennis TV 4zNsWcQ8jcY 现场声：30-30 主裁先喊 let，视频回看后宣布 my call came after he hit the ball，分判给西西帕斯，成赛点。
_facts.second_drop: 同上：赛点（30-40）再掉球，这一分重打，弗里茨救下赛点。主裁现场解释：Well, but the first one, he already lost the point. It was not replayed.
_facts.rule: 2026 ATP 官方规则书（2026-04-27 版）7.22 F 2(a)：Inadvertent distractions may include ... a ball falling out of a pocket ... (a “Let” may be called in these cases) ... Any player who created the hindrance must be advised that the next time play is stopped by the Chair Umpire because of that player’s similar actions; it shall result in a loss of point. 7.22 G「Opponent’s Gear Falls On The Court」：The Chair Umpire shall call a let and replay the point. He shall also inform the player that if the Chair Umpire makes a second call of let, it will result in a loss of point. ITF 网球规则 2026 第 26 条：the point shall be replayed if a player is hindered in playing the point by either an unintentional act of the opponent(s)...
_facts.quote_atp: ATP 同一篇引西西帕斯：I was manifesting today's match（本片未用）。
